## Weapons & Ammo
Weapons in Reclamation Project range from improvised pistols to military-grade energy guns and heavy weapons. Ammunition matters just as much as the weapon itself - learn what your gear uses before you head into a fight.
## Weapon Families
[bold]Ranged Weapons[/bold]
Description: Firearms, energy guns, and heavy weapons.
[bold]Melee Weapons[/bold]
Description: Knives, clubs, spears, and other close-combat gear.
[bold]Explosives[/bold]
Description: Grenades, launchers, mines, and demolition tools.
[bold]Other Weapons[/bold]
Description: Miscellaneous and specialty weapons.
## Ammunition Basics
Always match the weapon to the correct magazine, cartridge, cell, or shell. Running dry in the middle of a fight is usually fatal.
[bold]9mm Magazine[/bold]
Used By: 9mm Pistol, SMG
[bold]10mm Magazine[/bold]
Used By: 10mm Pistol, Revolver, SMG
[bold].45 Magazine[/bold]
Used By: .45 Pistol, Revolver
[bold]5.56 Magazine[/bold]
Used By: R91 Rifle, Carbine, Varmint Rifle, Tribal variants
[bold]7.62 Magazine[/bold]
Used By: Chinese Assault Rifle
[bold].308 Magazine[/bold]
Used By: .308 Lever Rifle, Hunting Sniper
[bold]Energy Cell[/bold]
Used By: Laser Pistols, Laser Rifles, Gatling Laser
[bold]Plasma Cell[/bold]
Used By: Plasma Pistols, Plasma Rifles, Plasma Caster
See the sub-sections for detailed listings on each weapon category.
